statement: The Strait of Hormuz stays effectively closed to unescorted commercial traffic through the 3 November US midterms.
basis: UKMTO reported projectile strikes on tankers off Oman on 3 November and north of Qatar on 4 November, an India-flagged vessel was struck off Oman on 3 November with one crew member killed, and the IMO count stood at 130 verified attacks and 25 seafarer deaths after the 5 November attack. No reopening agreement existed at the horizon.
judgment_title: Hormuz stays effectively closed to unescorted traffic through mid-December

statement: Iranian state-linked cyber operations against US and allied critical infrastructure continue through the 3 November US midterms.
basis: France attributed the October attacks on Danfoss refrigeration controllers at about 700 retail sites to the IRGC-linked Shahid Kaveh group, which places a state-linked campaign against allied infrastructure inside the window. The outcome rests on one state attribution; the reported disruption at US military commissaries stays unattributed.
judgment_title: Iranian cyber pressure on US and allied infrastructure through year-end
